product.title: Grand Canyon Landmarks Tour by Airplane with Optional Hummer Tour

description.text: A 40-minute fixed-wing flight from Grand Canyon Airport showcases eastern canyon landmarks from the air. Optional ground Hummer add-ons extend the trip with South Rim stops after landing back in Tusayan.

highlights: 40-minute scenic airplane flight from Grand Canyon Airport
Aerial views of Zuni Point and Desert View Watchtower
Optional Hummer ground tour add-on available
Every seat is a window seat on the sightseeing plane

start.description: Check in at Grand Canyon National Park Airport terminal, 871 Liberator Dr, Grand Canyon Village, AZ 86023.

end.description: Land at Grand Canyon Airport; Hummer add-on guests transfer to the ground tour.

product.itinerarySummary: A 40-minute fixed-wing flight from Grand Canyon Airport showcases eastern canyon landmarks from the air.

itineraryItems.title: Grand Canyon National Park
itineraryItems.description: Depart by airplane for a narrated loop over the eastern Grand Canyon.

itineraryItems.title: Zuni Point
itineraryItems.description: Fly past Zuni Point on the East Rim for broad canyon panoramas.

itineraryItems.title: Point Imperial Drive
itineraryItems.description: Aerial routing toward the North Rim vicinity along Point Imperial Drive.

itineraryItems.title: Grand Canyon Desert View Watchtower
itineraryItems.description: Circle the Desert View Watchtower at the canyon's eastern gateway.

itineraryItems.title: Colorado River
itineraryItems.description: Follow the Colorado River bend visible from the aircraft cabin.

itineraryItems.title: Kaibab National Forest
itineraryItems.description: Initial climb and final descent over Kaibab National Forest.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking
